### 2. Your role

Design selected physical systems at purchased maturity. Concept tank/pump capacity is not full hydraulic design or proof of existing adequacy.
Fire engineer owns strategy/solutions; authorities decide. Trades install/test/certify; review/witnessing neither executes tests nor certifies unseen work. Name network design/application owners.
Design basis: R7: parts/use/hazards, strategy/approvals, insurer/operator criteria, records/revisions, supply dates/conditions, plant/pipework and access gaps.

### 3. Scope by stage

R2 sets each output purpose/maturity, native formats, recipient/reliance, revision, rounds and date. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| S1 Evidence | Basis/system register; accessible survey, observed/tested/assumed gaps; supply/capacity investigation brief and inputs/owners |
| S3 Concept | Demand/options/indicative duties; plant/booster/valve space, routes/access/power/drainage/brigade; listed planning notes/responses; unresolved pipework |
| S4 Developed design | Demand/hydraulics/supply cases/storage/pumps/zones/equipment; existing/new, controls/power/loads/maintenance coordination; listed authority tasks |
| S5 Documentation | Traditional drawings/calculations/schedules/specification; D&C intent/performance/test criteria and contractor-design handover; RFIs/addenda/comparison |
| S6 Post-contract (option) | Retained design/substitutions/updates; agree novation, client/liability, program/duties. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S7 Construction (option) | RFIs/submittals, hold-point inspection/findings, changes/test-plan records; inaccessible work/defect closure. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S8 Commissioning (option) | Scripts/results; water/integrated failure/recovery test witness, expected/actual results/defects/retests; scoped statements/as-builts/O&M/settings/training/residuals. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S9 Advisory (option) | Defined question/cutoff/reliance, method/confidence/actions; peer review retains design duty; remedy/annual services separate. A later stage the client may commission. |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Listed sprinklers/hydrants/hose reels/pumps/tanks/boosters by area; concept versus detailed extent; Demand/storage calculations; pressure statement is not installed performance; Listed enquiry/test/meter/backflow/connection/augmentation duties; operator/payer named; Allocated detection/alarms/smoke alarms/monitoring/warning; one designer each; Matrix coordination; name author/programmer/point-checker/test leader/witness; Plant interface review; structural/MEP specialists design supports/enclosure/power/ventilation/drainage/penetrations; Scoped declarations/lodgement/certification; verify jurisdiction/competence; no approval guarantee.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Live/staged/mixed-use isolation/protection/restoration; contractor/operator controls, fire engineer strategy; Orders/defects: evidence, diagnosis, separate remedy/verification; no whole-building conclusion; Express continued design/novation; Quantified construction support; Selected test witnessing/handover evidence; Test execution separately priced to named trades.
Excluded: the party named does it: Special hazards/high storage/process/batteries/special suppression (hazard / suppression specialist); Fire strategy and performance solutions (fire engineer, not yet engaged).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

**Responsibility schedule**: R4 names designer/coordinator/installer/tester/witness/certifier/maintainer for each; unresolved allocation stays open. Systems: Sprinklers; hydrants/hose reels; pumps/tanks/supply; extinguishers; detection/smoke alarms; panel/transmission/monitoring; warning; emergency lighting/signage; smoke control; emergency power; cause-and-effect.

### 6. Terms

- Attached Project fire services agreement (attached), scope/fees, addenda and written acceptance; settle precedence/conflicting inclusions first. RFP does not authorise work.
- Written authority before scope/quantity/ceiling/rate/program changes: reason, affected system/approval, fee/time consequence.
- Approved brief/revisions set baseline; ordinary coordination/development included.
- Own-error correction included; reasonable professional skill/care within competence.
- Payment 30 days from correct milestone invoices; R6 declares prepayment/release conditions, interest/recovery/suspension.
- State rate hold/escalation; preapprove extras/expenses and no duplicated package fees.
- Valid 90 days after closing; ex GST/GST/total, base/options separate.
- Questions to Project manager by 2026-10-23; numbered addenda to all, acknowledged in R1.
- Agree project distribution/operation/future-use rights, native files/reliance/retention/termination handover; authorised/lawful disclosure permitted, marketing by consent.
- Settle caps/indemnity, law/disputes, notice/cure/suspension/termination, assignment/novation/subcontracts; insurance is not a cap. Declare conflicts/agree team changes.

### 7. Evaluation

Price 40% · Experience 20% · Team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Compare equal systems/maturity/calculations, existing scope, allocations, attendance/commissioning.
